title: Vishnu Sahasranamam
desc: The Vishnu Sahasranamam is a Sanskrit hymn containing a list of the 1,000 names of Vishnu, one of the main deities in Hinduism and the Supreme God in Vaishnavism. It is one of the most sacred and popular stotras in Hinduism.

title: Lalitha Sahasranamam
desc: The Lalita Sahasranama is a Hindu religious text that enumerates the thousand names of Mother Goddess Lalita, which are held sacred in Hinduism particularly in Shaktism, the tradition focused on the worship of the Divine Feminine, Shakti.
